title: WYNONNA JUDD – The Hard Truth Tour
seo_title: Wynonna Judd: The Hard Truth Tour in Springfield, MO
description: Country singer Wynonna Judd performs live in concert on The Hard Truth Tour, featuring her more personal recent music along with her well-known voice. She first became famous with her mother, Naomi, in The Judds, who had eight consecutive No. 1 hits before she went solo. It takes place Friday, February 19, 2027 at 7:30 PM at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts

organizer.name: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
